> 第25章 猎魔人（第1页）
冰窟里的血腥味浓得化不开，混着那股铁锈内脏的腥甜，熏得凯撒脑仁疼。
凯撒靠在冰冷的岩壁上，猩红大剑搁在腿上，剑身上那些搏动的暗红脉络光芒正肉眼可见地黯淡下去，熟悉的的感觉传来，带着酸软和眩晕。
凯撒瞥了一眼被小咔冰封起来的巨大肉山，那东西被厚厚的寒冰包裹着，像个琥珀标本，但凯撒脑子里挥之不去的，是最后刺入心脏时，那双浑浊眼睛里闪过的哀求。
凯撒低声嘟囔了一句，这让他想起了铁皮村的村民。
凯撒用力甩甩头，想把那眼神甩出去，管它以前是啥，现在它就是块材料，他摸了摸怀里皮袋子里那颗温热的血肉核心，它似乎还在跳动。
凯撒的视线扫过冰洞，角落一个黑乎乎的东西让他停住了目光，他撑着还有点发麻的腿，晃晃悠悠地站起来。
那是个磨损得很厉害的黑色皮包，边角都磨得发白，一看就有些年头了，他估摸着，八成是那冰疙瘩里怪物的东西。
凯撒用下巴点了点地上的皮包，又指了指冰里那坨扭曲的肉块。
小咔依旧只会发出这个音节，但小脑袋用力点了点，意思倒是清楚了。
凯撒没敢直接上手，谁知道这老古董包里会不会藏着什么要命的东西。
凯撒抄起地上那根铁矛，小心地用矛尖去挑开皮包的搭扣，一点点把包口拨开。
只见里面赫然装着一些纳尔，然后就是两本厚实的兽皮书，还有一卷压得有点皱巴的纸，看着像是封信。
凯撒放下铁矛，小心地拿起那卷纸，慢慢展开。
上面的字迹有些潦草，像是匆忙间写下的。
【我不行了…我的身体正在发生异化，看到我的朋友，不要犹豫…杀掉我，并小心一个邪恶的巫师，我用特殊的方法切断了与他的联系，但阻止不了他多久……
最后，把我的传承带上，别让它被永远冰封…
在维斯洛特大陆，有传承的猎魔人和没有传承的，那差别可大了，这就相当于是自学和带老师的区别。
凯撒立马拿起地上那两本厚厚的兽皮书，这来得太是时候了。

凯撒现在对这片大陆的了解，怕是连路边随便出来的魔物都分不清，有了这两本书，他才算真正有了当猎魔人的资格。
凯撒翻开其中一本，似乎记载的是大陆上的一些魔物信息，光食尸鬼就有七八种。
从普通尸体腐化所产生的食尸鬼，再到蚕食尸体而不消化，产生的异化硬皮食尸鬼，还有大陆上一些常见魔物的记载，怨魂、亡灵……
另一本书则是更为珍贵，是凯诺传承的魔药配方，魔药配方基本上是每个猎魔人的不传之秘，都是经过每一代的实验组合才创造出的特殊魔药。
凯撒略微一翻，上面足足记载了十几种，狼人药剂，鱼鳃药剂，甚至还有受孕药剂，下面还标注了一行小字，男性也可以使用……
凯撒很快压下兴奋的情绪，想到了凯诺信中提到的邪恶巫师和他自己的状态，凯撒脑子里瞬间闪过铁皮村里那些被诡异蠕虫寄生变成吸血怪物的村民。
“而且追踪手段还在……只是暂时被屏蔽了。”
凯撒眉头紧皱，一股强烈的危机感袭来，如果真的是同一个人，那么我是否也暴露了呢？

> Chapter 25 Demon Hunter (Page 1)
The smell of blood in the ice cave was so strong that it couldn't be dissolved. Mixed with the sweet smell of rusty internal organs, it made Caesar's brain hurt.
Caesar leaned against the cold rock wall, with the scarlet sword resting on his lap. The pulsating dark red veins of light on the sword were dimming visibly to the naked eye, and a familiar feeling came, with soreness and dizziness.
Caesar glanced at the huge mountain of flesh sealed by Xiaoka's ice. The thing was wrapped in thick ice, like an amber specimen, but what lingered in Caesar's mind was the pleading that flashed in those cloudy eyes when it finally pierced his heart.
Caesar muttered something under his breath, which reminded him of the villagers of Ironhide Village.
Caesar shook his head hard, trying to get rid of that look. No matter what it was before, it was just a piece of material now. He touched the warm flesh and blood core in the leather bag in his arms, and it seemed to be still beating.
Caesar's eyes swept across the ice cave, and a dark object in the corner stopped him. He stood up unsteadily on his still numb legs.
It was a very worn black leather bag, with the corners turned white. It looked quite old at first glance. He estimated that it probably belonged to the monster in the ice lump.
Caesar tapped the leather bag on the ground with his chin, and then pointed at the twisted piece of flesh in the ice.
Xiaoka could still only pronounce this syllable, but when he nodded his head hard, the meaning became clear.
Caesar didn't dare to take action directly. Who knew if there might be something deadly hidden in this old antique bag.
Caesar picked up the iron spear on the ground, carefully used the tip of the spear to open the buckle of the leather bag, and opened the mouth of the bag bit by bit.
I saw some Gnar inside, then two thick animal skin books, and a roll of paper that was a little wrinkled, and it looked like a letter.
Caesar put down the iron spear, carefully picked up the roll of paper, and slowly unfolded it.
The handwriting on it is a bit sloppy, as if it was written in a hurry.
[I can't do it anymore... My body is undergoing alienation. If you see my friends, don't hesitate... kill me, and be careful of an evil wizard. I used a special method to cut off the connection with him, but I can't stop him for long...
Finally, take my inheritance with you and don’t let it be frozen forever...
In the continent of Westeros, there is a big difference between demon hunters with inheritance and those without inheritance. This is equivalent to the difference between self-study and taking a teacher.
Caesar immediately picked up the two thick animal skin books on the ground. This came at the perfect time.
Caesar's current understanding of this continent is that he may not even be able to distinguish monsters that come out randomly on the roadside. With these two books, he can truly be qualified to be a demon hunter.
Caesar opened one of the books, which seemed to contain information about some monsters on the continent. There were seven or eight types of ghouls alone.
From the ghouls produced by the decay of ordinary corpses, to the alienated crusty ghouls produced by cannibalizing corpses without digesting them, there are also records of some common monsters on the mainland, resentful souls, undead...
The other book is even more precious. It is the magic potion formula inherited by Kainuo. The magic potion formula is basically the secret of every demon hunter. It is a special potion created after each generation of experimental combinations.
Caesar flipped through it slightly, and found that there were more than a dozen kinds of drugs listed on it, including werewolf potions, fish gill potions, and even fertility potions. There was also a line of small words marked below, which said men could also use it...
Caesar quickly suppressed his excitement and thought of the evil wizard mentioned in Keno's letter and his own state. Caesar's mind flashed to the villagers in Ironhide Village who were transformed into blood-sucking monsters by strange worms.
"And the tracking method is still there...it's just temporarily blocked."
Caesar frowned, and a strong sense of crisis came over him. If it is really the same person, then I amWas it also exposed?
